facts.text: Formed in July 2022 through the merger of California, Clarion, and Edinboro universities, PennWest operates three physical residential campuses and a Global Online campus.

sources.title: About PennWest
sources.quote: In July 2022, these three proud institutions came together to form PennWest University — a forward-thinking, student-centered university designed to meet the needs of today's learners while honoring the history and identity of each campus.

sources.title: About PennWest
sources.quote: Today, PennWest serves students across Pennsylvania and beyond through campuses in California, Clarion, Edinboro, and a comprehensive Global Online presence.
